frame: floor_cm (PROVISIONAL_UNVALIDATED mat-seam homography); grid = BEV raster 4 px/cm, cell 8 px = 2 cm; cell (r, c) centre = ((c + 0.5) * 2 - pad, (r + 0.5) * 2 - pad) cm, pad = 10 cm
not_a_single_px_per_cm_on_the_photo: image px -> floor cm via the homography; no uniform scale is applied to the photo
start_status: ESTIMATED (stored robot box centre; heading UNKNOWN)
footprint_rule: 35.0x24.0 cm user size + 3.5 cm/side floor-transform margin; whole rectangle must lie on free floor (erosion); fixed heading per map

cost.safety: v0.2 cost_field SAFETY_COST_ASTAR (path length + risk term inside the 10 cm soft margin), cm-equivalent; equals v0.2 A* cost
cost.distance: v0.2 cost_field DISTANCE_ONLY edges: 8-connected grid geodesic length (cm); the simplified any-angle path is shorter or equal

dynamics: NOT modelled (cost is geometric; mecanum slip/acceleration not represented)

rotation.test: only at reachable cells whose circumscribed disc is free (v0.2-style conservative rotation test); rotation adds no length (time/dynamics NOT modelled)

nav_to_area_box.note: ZERO_LENGTH_PATH: the start already is the approach pose

not_confused_with: placement_reach_map gaps are body-edge-to-point distances; these are path costs from the start
